tick_time.description: Time in milliseconds for each tick — used as the base unit for timeouts and heartbeats.

init_limit.description: Number of ticks that followers are allowed to connect and sync to a leader during initial startup.

sync_limit.description: Number of ticks that followers are allowed to respond to heartbeats from the leader before being considered out-of-sync.

data_log_dir.description: Path to the directory storing transaction logs. Using a dedicated disk improves performance.

data_dir.description: Path to the directory storing snapshot data files. Should be on persistent, reliable storage.

client_port.description: Port on which ZooKeeper accepts client connections (e.g., from applications).

client_bind_address.description: IP address or hostname to bind the client port to. Use 'localhost' for local-only access or a specific interface in production.

max_client_cnxns.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections per IP address. Increase for high-client-count deployments.

four_letter_words_whitelist.description: Comma-separated list of allowed four-letter commands (e.g., 'stat,ruok,conf'). Use '' or 'none' to disable for security.

group_digest_enabled.description: Enable DigestAuthenticationProvider (prevents anonymous access). Enable only with proper SASL/Simple auth setup.

secure_client_port.description: Port for TLS-encrypted client connections (e.g., 2281). Requires certificate configuration; set >0 to enable.

servers.description: List of voting ensemble members. Each element must have an `id`, `hostname`, `peer_port`, `leader_port`, and optionally `role`.

observers.description: List of observer servers (non-voting members). Same structure as `servers`, but `role` must be 'observer'.
